verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's main structure. The thin frame that surrounded the headline is now an empty box floating above the text, a stray grey rectangle sits next to the icon, the leaf imagery is almost gone, and the bulb icon and divider lines are pushed off into a bottom corner. B has all the same flaws and is also shifted down, so the grey block, icon and lines are jammed against the bottom edge with no margin; that makes A slightly less bad.
